speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for coming in. speaker: Patient
text: 55-year-old male bodybuilder. The patient has been experiencing weakness in his right arm for a few weeks, which has progressively worsened to the point of dropping objects. He also reports a recent unexplained weight loss of 17 pounds and has a history of diabetes. The patient admits to chronic alcohol use, heavy smoking, and anabolic steroid use.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Peripheral Neuropathy (likely Diabetic Amyotrophy or steroid-induced neuropathy). The patient's history of diabetes, heavy alcohol use, and steroid use strongly suggests a metabolic or toxic cause for his progressive right arm weakness and weight loss. I will request blood work to check glucose control, electrolytes, and liver enzymes, and a nerve conduction study to confirm the diagnosis.
